worker_notes: Identity independently verified: article title at P1 L48–50, all seven authors at P1 L51–57, DOI 10.1177/19485506211056761 at P1 L46 match reference. Cover P0 L12–13 identifies Publisher's PDF/version of record. Full parse contains methods, results, discussion, references and biographies, not an abstract-only excerpt. Cover gives 2022 publication and article gives 2021 copyright; same DOI and authors support online-first/reference identity. No PDF path supplied; rendering unavailable. Target matched by explicitly named second study/Prolific sample (P3 L268–272), requested r metric and risk-benefit t-value correlation paragraph pp.4–5; no row-order or numeric matching. Frozen provenance explicitly says leading 2 in negative numbers is a minus-sign extraction artifact. Thus canonical 2.84 is recorded as -.84; quotes preserve canonical text. Same-test p is < .001, canonical backslash .001. Analytic N unresolved: correlation inputs are t-values, not participants. The final Prolific participant count is explicitly 776 (P4 L286–289; P10 note 5 L682–686). These are contributor participants, after 40 preregistered exclusions and 192 exclusions from an additional condition. Figure 1 names four direction/attribute manipulations and three technologies but does not explicitly print the number of correlation inputs. No N inferred from df, no product used as analytic N, and participant counts not substituted for t-value pairs. Authors explicitly say successfully replicated (P7 L494–499); successful records their narrative verdict. They also identify the low-benefit exception on pp.7–8 L494–529.
